description: This file contains test cases for the `litellm` proxy system, focusing on the logging payload generation, request sanitization, and truncation logic. It uses pytest for testing various aspects of spend logs payload creation, including handling large request bodies, conditional inclusion of prompts, and flexible string length configurations.

classes.name: litellm.ModelResponse
classes.description: Represents a model response containing generated choices, usage, and metadata.

classes.name: litellm.Choices
classes.description: Represents a choice in a generated response, including content, role, and finish reason.

classes.name: litellm.Message
classes.description: Represents a message with role and content, part of a conversation.

classes.name: litellm.Usage
classes.description: Tracks token usage for prompt and completion.

methods.name: test_spend_logs_payload(model_id: Optional[str])
methods.description: Tests the generation of spend logs payload given a complex model interaction, ensuring correct metadata and tags.

methods.name: test_spend_logs_payload_whisper()
methods.description: Tests logging payload for transcription responses, verifying cost and call type.

methods.name: test_spend_logs_payload_with_prompts_enabled(monkeypatch)
methods.description: Verifies inclusion of prompt messages and responses in spend logs when logging of prompts is enabled.

methods.name: test_large_request_no_truncation_threshold()
methods.description: Checks that long request bodies are truncated appropriately based on MAX_STRING_LENGTH_PROMPT_IN_DB.

methods.name: test_small_request_no_truncation()
methods.description: Ensures small request bodies are not truncated when below the threshold.

methods.name: test_configurable_string_length_env_var(monkeypatch)
methods.description: Verifies that the maximum string length for prompts can be configured via environment variable.

methods.name: test_truncation_preserves_beginning_and_end()
methods.description: Ensures that truncation preserves the start and end segments of the original content for better debugging.
